tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Transport by a Smooth Family of Linear Maps is Smooth]

↗ def:bilinear-comp-of-family

If $b$ is smooth, $F$ is smooth at $p_0$, and the tangent-coordinate representation of $A_p$ is smooth at $p_0$, then $p\mapsto (A^*b)_p$ is smooth at $p_0$.
Proof

↗ def:bilinear-comp-of-family \sketch In tangent coordinates the field is $p\mapsto B(F(p))(D(p)\cdot ,D(p)\cdot )$, a smooth expression linear in $B$ and quadratic in the smooth family $D$.

□

This transport also covers horizontal lifts used in Theorem 3, where $A_p$ need not be a differential.
